grapple.name: Grapple
grapple.description: Using the Grapple costs 0 AP and can propel this soldier up to 15 tiles clearing this unit from all overwatching aliens. Single use only.

advanced-grapple.name: Advanced Grapple
advanced-grapple.description: Using the Grapple costs 0 AP and can propel this soldier up to 15 tiles clearing this unit from all overwatching aliens. 3 uses.

damage-control.name: Damage Control
damage-control.description: Grants +5% DR each time damage is received. If at full HP, grants +50 crit resist. If shredded, reduce shred to a maximum of 50% at end of turn.

repulsor.name: Repulsor
repulsor.description: If at full HP, non-psionic attacks are repulsed, causing them to graze (dealing only half of the original damage).

sealed.name: Sealed
sealed.description: Internal air supply and oxygen recycling systems grant the wearer immunity to strangulation.

flame-resistant.name: Flame Resistant
flame-resistant.description: Internal vapor chambers with intergrated cooling systems grant this unit with complete immunity to fire hazards.

tactical-mobility.name: Tactical Mobility
tactical-mobility.description: This unit gains 30 defense when in cover or flying. Does not apply to reaction fire. Disabled if this unit has been damaged this turn or is disoriented.

ghost.name: Ghost
ghost.description: Activate to turn invisible until your next action or next turn (2-turn cooldown). Cannot Ghost while Holo-Targeted. Attacks made while Ghosted gain +30 crit.

psi-boost.name: Psi Boost
psi-boost.description: Infuses explosives to deal 1 bonus psionic damage. Increases Kinetic Blast and Rift damage by 2. Reduces accumulation of fatigue by 20%.

advanced-psi-boost.name: Advanced Psi Boost
advanced-psi-boost.description: Infuses explosives to deal 2 bonus psionic damage. Increases Kinetic Blast and Rift damage by 4. Reduces accumulation of fatigue by 50%.

steady-weapon.name: Steady Weapon
steady-weapon.description: Shots do not graze, bypass half of impenetrable cover, gain double base aim, +15 pen, and reaction fire immunity. Rocket range +20%, scatter -75%. Lost if unit acts, is hit, or swaps weapons. Steadying does not trigger reaction fire.

aerial-precision.name: Aerial Precision
aerial-precision.description: Grants +20 crit and +50% crit damage against airborne targets.

burst.name: Burst
burst.description: Fire a +20 aim shot. Requires 2 ammo.

volume-fire.name: Volume Fire
volume-fire.description: High fire volume grants +75% base damage vs exposed, pincered, or point-blank enemies, reduces enemy graze chance by 25, and increases distortion maluses by 50%.

hip-fire.name: Hip Fire
hip-fire.description: Accuracy gains on standard shots above 60% hit chance only contribute half to final hit chance.

bulletstorm.name: Bulletstorm
bulletstorm.description: Spray fire across a 30 degree cone out to 18 tiles. Every enemy in the cone has 2x 20% chances (10% with an LMG) to take Standard Shot Damage. Enemies not hit have a 50% chance to take 1 damage. Requires 2 ammo.

shredder.name: Shredder
shredder.description: Primary weapon attacks apply Shred equal to the damage dealt as a percent of the target's max HP (which increases subsequent damage the target receives by the amount of Shred) for the remainder of the battle.

danger-zone.name: Danger Zone
danger-zone.description: Suppression affects (with half suppressive fire damage) targets in a 2.5 tile radius around the primary target.

maim.name: Maim
maim.description: Fire 2 shots with an aim malus of -5 per HP of the target. The shots deal 1 damage each. Any damage against a biological target with 1 HP will Maim the target instead of dealing damage, preventing the target from performing reactive fire and skipping it's next turn.

light-volume-fire.name: Light Volume Fire
light-volume-fire.description: High fire volume grants +50% base damage vs exposed, pincered, or point-blank enemies and reduces enemy graze chance by 15.

overload.name: Overload
overload.description: Standard shots against mechanical units clear overwatch and reactive targeting sensors and have a chance to disorient targets equal to the percent of max HP they lost. Triple the chance vs SHIVs.

stun.name: Stun
stun.description: Non-lethal, short-range arc attack that has a chance to stun biological targets. Any target at or below 4 HP that resists the stun will be maimed instead. Stun chance increases if target is at low HP.

ether-shredder.name: Ether Shredder
ether-shredder.description: Primary weapon attacks apply Shred equal to the damage dealt as a percent of the target's max HP (which increases subsequent damage the target receives by the amount of Shred) to any unit with distortion for the remainder of the battle.

sublimator.name: Sublimator
sublimator.description: Grants +10 penetration vs hardened targets and deals triple damage to Plasma Shields.

panzer-shredder.name: Panzer Shredder
panzer-shredder.description: Primary weapon attacks apply Shred equal to the damage dealt as a percent of the target's max HP (which increases subsequent damage the target receives by the amount of Shred) to any grounded mechanical unit for the remainder of the battle.

aerial-shredder.name: Aerial Shredder
aerial-shredder.description: Primary weapon attacks apply Shred equal to the damage dealt as a percent of the target's max HP (which increases subsequent damage the target receives by the amount of Shred) to any flying-capable unit for the remainder of the battle.

aerial-tracking.name: Aerial Tracking
aerial-tracking.description: Shots from the primary weapon ignore the 30 defense bonus flying targets receive.

carapace-shredder.name: Carapace Shredder
carapace-shredder.description: Primary weapon attacks apply Shred equal to the damage dealt as a percent of the target's max HP (which increases subsequent damage the target receives by the amount of Shred) to any hardened biologic unit for the remainder of the battle.
